title: Tuning A Rotating Black Hole Spectrum with Dark Matter Halo: Quasibound States, Scalar Cloud, Black Hole Bomb and Superradiant Scattering
summary: We investigate the spectral dynamics of a rotating black hole embedded in a Dehnen $(1,4,γ)$ dark matter halo, where quasibound states and superradiant scattering jointly characterize the physical response of the system. Starting from an exact Schwarzschild--Dehnen solution, we construct its rotating counterpart via the Newman--Janis algorithm, yielding a consistent axisymmetric geometry that incorporates the influence of a structured halo.
